title: Special Array With X Elements Greater Than or Equal X
summary: Given an array of non-negative integers, determine if there exists a number x such that exactly x elements in the array are greater than or equal to x.
statement: Given an array of non-negative integers, determine if there exists a number x such that exactly x elements in the array are greater than or equal to x. If such an x exists, return x; otherwise, return -1. Confirm that if the array is special, x is unique.
constraints: Return the unique x such that exactly x entries are at least x, or -1.
hints: Only values from one through n can equal their own qualifying count.
Test each candidate against the count of entries at least that candidate.
The qualifying count never increases as x grows, so at most one crossing can satisfy count=x.
